## Indicateurs {width="30%"}
```{r don}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Don de bidoux"
list(
  icon = "coin",
  color = "#daa520",
  value = paste0(n, "$")
)
```

```{r nombre}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Nombre total de sortie"
list(
  icon = "check2-circle",
  color = "primary",
  value = n
)
```

```{r km}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Nombre total de kilomètre"
list(
  icon = "signpost-split",
  color = "light",
  value = paste(round(km_sum, 1), "km")
)
```

```{r elevation}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Nombre total d'élévation"
list(
  icon = "chevron-double-up",
  color = "light",
  value = paste(round(ele_sum, 1), "m")
)
```
